create_behavior_parameters: create a BehaviorParameters object to configure stance duration, forward speed, turning speed, and standing height for the Raibert controller
generate_swing_trajectory: generate a swing leg trajectory using phase, init pose, and end pose to compute desired leg swing and extension values
generate_stance_trajectory: generate a stance leg trajectory using phase, init pose, and end pose to compute desired leg pose during stance phase
run_raibert_controller: run the MinitaurRaibertController with a robot and behavior parameters to get desired motor angles for trotting gait locomotion
estimate_base_velocity: estimate the current center of mass speed of the Minitaur robot based on stance leg pose and phase information
